messages.content:
To get the contestants’ info (number + name), query the `CONTESTANTS` table:

```sql
SELECT contestant_number, contestant_name
FROM CONTESTANTS
ORDER BY contestant_number;
```

If you meant something else by “contestants info” (e.g., vote counts per contestant, votes by state, etc.), tell me what fields/summary you want.
focus on the contestants that got at least two votes

```sql
SELECT
  c.contestant_number,
  c.contestant_name,
  COUNT(*) AS vote_count
FROM CONTESTANTS c
JOIN VOTES v
  ON v.contestant_number = c.contestant_number
GROUP BY c.contestant_number, c.contestant_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY vote_count DESC, c.contestant_number;
```
